findings.claim: Four live, read-only MCP tools -- read_chapter, list_classical_texts, find_verses_about, and search_classical_texts (F-07) -- are 100% unreachable for any argument. findings.claim: kala_now_get performs no entitlement/existence check on chart_id before doing substantial work, unlike every other chart-scoped tool tested in this audit (ganita_chart_facts_get, assess_career, judgment_query, dossier, catalog_chart_select all cleanly reject a nonexistent chart_id with ENTITLEMENT_DENIED/AUTHZ_DENIED before any computation). findings.claim: The shared ENTITLEMENT_DENIED error message template used by ganita_chart_facts_get / assess_career / judgment_query (and similar registry_bridge-backed tools) unconditionally states '(distinct from an empty result — this chart exists but you are not granted)' even when the chart_id supplied is a syntactically-valid but entirely fabricated/nonexistent UUID. The message asserts a specific fact ('this chart exists') that is false in the nonexistent-UUID case, conflating two genuinely different situations (real chart the caller lacks access to, vs. no such chart at all) into one message that actively misstates the nonexistent case. This is a narration-fidelity issue, not a security leak — the denial itself is appropriately generic/safe — but the message text should not assert existence it cannot verify.

findings.claim: gochara_forecast_get's tool description explicitly documents a guarantee (the 'S4-05 fix'): passing `domain` gets 'an explicit not_covered refusal with a cross_pointer to the capable instrument (kala_windows_get) instead of relying on silence' whenever the sweep does not cover that domain — specifically to prevent a caller from misreading silence on a domain as an all-clear. journey_reports.f14_impact_assessment: F-14 (assess_health never returns 'reading'/domain_completeness/completeness_directive for any chart, health or otherwise) is confirmed again here on BOTH charts at reading_depth='deep_dive' (evidence: assess_health__native_deep_dive.json, assess_health__zero_deep_dive.json — content keys present are domain, domain_label, chart_id, ayanamsha_id, ranking_basis, verdict, reading_checklist, verdict_skeleton, step_results, house_analysis, karaka_analysis, varga_analysis, sensitive_degree_firings, kp_cusp_chain, gochara_sweep, activating_dasha, contradictions, yoga_fact_ids, citations, judgment_flags, provenance — no 'reading', 'domain_completeness', or 'completeness_directive' key in either). MEASURED IMPACT ON THE JOURNEY: materially small, not a black hole. assess_health's own content.verdict.clauses field independently supplies a 5-sentence grounded narrative for the native chart ('Health / Vitality assessment draws on 10 composite-ranked signal(s)...', '13 yoga(s) fired... but none name only this domain's bhāveśa/kāraka(s)... shown for context, not domain-confirmed', 'Ṣaṣṭhāṁśa (D6) placements were consumed directly from L1...', '1 domain-tagged tension(s) surfaced...', 'A dated daśā-activation window is available...'), each clause carrying fact_ids and an explicit grounded:true/false flag. Alongside that, assess_health serves content.contradictions (domain-filtered to health, 1 of 3 chart-wide tensions), content.discoveries, content.activating_dasha (real dasha date windows), and content.gochara_sweep — the SAME domain='health' forward-transit sweep judgment_query independently computes (upcoming_window_count=17 for native / 8 for zero, identical top illness_acute/chronic_onset/surgery windows with peak dates, in both tools). judgment_query (called separately with domain='health') is in fact richer than the missing digest would have been: it returns a full classical checklist (bhava/bhāveśa/kāraka condition from both lagna and chandra, D6 varga confirmation, bearing_yogas vs bearing_yogas_corroboration split, bearing_afflictions including the Saturn D1-exalted/D9-debilitated divergence and Sade Sati cycle end date, sensitive-degree firings, KP cusp chain, and a reading_checklist receipt disclosing units_served=8/12 with the 4 unserved units named explicitly). So a caller chaining judgment_query -> assess_health -> ganita_medical_get -> gochara_* for this exact question ends up with MORE synthesized narrative content than the single missing 'reading' field would have added, not less. The real cost of F-14 is narrower than 'the health journey is broken': it is (a) an API-contract violation for any caller that specifically probes content.reading / domain_completeness / completeness_directive as a completeness signal for the health domain and gets nothing back although the schema promises it, and (b) internal inconsistency versus other domains where those exact fields DO populate (established by the prior F-14 finding, not re-litigated here). Within THIS journey specifically, no user reading the assembled multi-tool answer would receive a materially worse or more shallow picture than intended, because the richer judgment_query call and assess_health's own verdict/contradictions/gochara_sweep sections carry the substantive content the missing digest would have wrapped in a different envelope.

(2) gochara_forecast_get / gochara_activation_get carry a domain-aware not_covered refusal path (per their own tool descriptions, the explicit S4-05 fix target scenario is verbatim 'is there a rough patch coming for my health?') — not exercised here because health WAS covered for both charts (coverage.domains_not_covered=[] on all 4 calls), but its presence means an uncovered domain would get a named refusal + cross_pointer to kala_windows_get rather than a misleading empty scan. Pass all:true to retrieve the full ~1950-2100 historical+future sweep' rather than silently truncating. The ONE partial exception, which is exactly the F-14 gap: assess_health's own top-level judgment_flags array (both charts, deep_dive) contains only 'budget_exceeded_after_trim' — it does NOT carry a flag disclosing that the documented reading/domain_completeness/completeness_directive fields are absent for this domain, even though the SAME response mechanism (judgment_flags) is actively used for a different, less consequential gap in the same payload. This is a real but narrow consistency defect: the rest of the health journey chain (especially judgment_query) treats 'a documented field silently vanishing' as build-fatal-worthy of a flag; assess_health's own reading-digest gap does not get the same treatment, in the same response, from the same tool family.

election_muhurta.f10_impact_on_kala_elect_get: kala_elect_get does NOT reproduce F-10's exact defect (total absence of any domain/action_class filter). Confirmed via platform-mcp/src/tools/kala_views/elect.ts:62, kala_elect_get delegates directly to handleMuhurtaFinder — the SAME underlying muhurta_finder.py/PH-4-4 engine kala_muhurta_get uses (both tools' provenance_envelope.asset='PH-4-4'). BUT the other two components — 50% of the total composite score — are computed identically regardless of undertaking: dasha_quality (30% weight, muhurta.py:372 _dasha_quality_for_chart(chart_id, window_start) takes NO action_type parameter; for the native chart returns a flat 0.72 for any year 2026-2043 irrespective of business/marriage/medical) and transit_quality (20% weight, muhurta.py:420 _transit_quality_for_window(window_start) also takes NO action_type parameter). A secondary, distinct defect: transit_quality is a misnomer — its implementation (muhurta.py:420-465) computes a lunar-phase (29.53-day cycle) approximation plus a static day-of-week table, with ZERO actual planetary-transit computation; the function's own docstring admits 'Full transit computation requires Swiss Ephemeris... All values are approximations only.' This is a §N.8 earned-signal violation: a field named 'transit_quality' with no transit detector behind it.
